name: Family history
description: Check and explore a family tree kept as a people CSV (id, name, sex, born, died, father, mother, spouse, married, source) or as a simple GEDCOM text file. Check finds impossible or doubtful dates (death before birth, a child born before a parent or after a mother's death, a parent too young or too old, a marriage before a birth or after a death), unknown parent ids, loops and facts with no source; Duplicates finds people who may be the same; Tree prints descendants or ancestors of a person as an indented tree; Report gives ages at death and the anniversaries in calendar order. Partial and approximate dates are never made precise. Nothing is invented: a missing relative, date or source is reported as missing. The original is never changed.

presets.label: Check dates and links
presets.description: Impossible dates, parents too young or old (limits adjustable: mother_min=15 mother_max=50 father_min=15 father_max=75 in the extra arguments), unknown ids, loops, missing sources, as file(line) findings.

presets.label: Find possible duplicate people
presets.description: People with the same name (any word order, accents ignored) and overlapping birth dates, shared parents or spouse. Candidates only.

presets.label: Descendants or ancestors tree
presets.description: Type person=ID (or a name) in the extra arguments, and dir=ancestors for ancestors (default descendants); depth=N limits the generations. An indented tree with years, spouses and sources.

presets.label: Ages and anniversaries
presets.description: Ages at death and the birthdays, death days and wedding days in calendar order. Type asof=2025-06-30 in the extra arguments to count to another date (default: today).
